svg.text: Notes
A at 375 and 320: the 2 invoices chip sits after Property and Unit, so you scroll the chip row sideways to find it.
A on touch: a tablet opens the chip's menu under it with 44px rows; a phone opens a titled Invoices sheet, as the Tenants chip does.
A on a computer: the sticky rail grows one line per invoice, and a fifth or sixth invoice can push Created off a short screen.
B at every size: one section above Photos and files, so a long photo grid never pushes the invoices down.
B rows: number, total and stage, totals and stages in fixed columns so they line up. One line at 320; a long number truncates first.
B on a phone: the section sits right after Checklist, on the first screen above the docked composer. Nothing drops.
Both: a click or tap opens the invoice page, and Back returns to the task. Oldest first, as the job's files are.
Both: Not an invoice never lists. With no invoices nothing shows, as Photos and files shows nothing when empty.
Stage words match the Invoices page: To review, To pay, Paid. Paid in --ok, the others in --fg-2.
References (Mobbin): Squarespace project Invoices section, HoneyBook project Payments, Jobber client Invoices tab.
